primitives.name: Launch Readiness Scorecard
primitives.verbatim_quote: ## Launch Blockers Anything red in launch-readiness scorecards, unverified P0 data, missing tests, compliance blockers, or unapproved public claims.
primitives.assumptions: Each blocker contributes binary penalty to S; S is monotonic decreasing with B_i.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When any B_i = 1, S < 50 indicates launch block.

layer2.mapping: GSI computes S as a weighted sum of test coverage, compliance flags, and P0 data veracity; GSE uses S to gate deployment.
